texts.helperText: Uses maskCharacter="●" instead of native password dots.

withoutToggle.title: Without toggle
withoutToggle.description: `showToggle={false}` removes the button and the value is always masked.

clearable.title: Clearable
clearable.description: `clearable` shows a button that empties the field while it has a value. It clears through the normal `onChange` path, so it works the same controlled or uncontrolled, and then fires `onClear`. `clearLabel` is the button's accessible name; it defaults to "Clear". The button sits before the show/hide toggle and, with `suffixIcon`, between the icon and the toggle.

texts.helperText: The button shows while the field has a value.

texts.label: Password
texts.errorMessage: Password must be at least 8 characters.

validRegex.title: Valid regex
validRegex.description: `validRegex` marks the field as invalid while the value does not match. An empty value is treated as valid.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: `isDisabled` locks the field and hides the button.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Three sizes: sm, md and lg. The show/hide toggle scales with the size too.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Besides the documented props, InputPassword accepts native <input> attributes (InputHTMLAttributes) except size, prefix and type. className goes to the <input> and wrapperClassName to the root container, which uses the InputText classes plus gem-input-password.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.toggle: The button uses aria-pressed and aria-controls; its aria-label switches between showPasswordLabel and hidePasswordLabel.
a11y.autoComplete: Defaults to autoComplete="current-password". Use new-password in sign-up forms.
a11y.mask: With maskCharacter the input switches to type="text" with spellCheck={false} so the value is not exposed.
a11y.label: helperText and errorMessage are linked with aria-describedby; the error and a failing validRegex use role="alert".

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: InputPassword combines the InputText classes with its own gem-input-password ones.

rules.clear: Clear button. Shown with `clearable` while the field has a value.
rules.suffix: Suffix icon when the button is also shown.
rules.label: Field label.
rules.field: Container for the input, icons and button.
rules.message: Helper or error text below the field.
rules.hasToggle: Applied when the button is shown.
rules.hasSuffixAndToggle: Applied with both `suffixIcon` and the button.
rules.nativeMask: Applied while the value is hidden with native dots.
rules.customMask: Applied while the value is hidden with `maskCharacter`.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: InputPassword has no variables of its own: it uses these gem-system tokens. Redefine them in your `wrapperClassName` to change only this field.

items.--gem-color-accent: Focus border and button color while the value is visible.
items.--gem-color-fg-muted: Placeholder, icons, button and helper text.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: It also accepts native <input> attributes except size, prefix and type.

items.visibleIcon: Icon while the value is visible (clicking it hides the value).
items.hiddenIcon: Icon while the value is hidden (clicking it reveals the value).
items.maskCharacter: Character used to mask the value (●, •, *). Replaces native dots.
items.showPasswordLabel: Accessible name of the button while the value is hidden.
items.hidePasswordLabel: Accessible name of the button while the value is visible.
items.label: Visible field label.
items.labelPlacement: Label position: above or on the border.
items.helperText: Hint below the field (hidden when `errorMessage` is shown).
items.errorMessage: Error copy. Marks the field as invalid.
items.infoText: Shows an info icon with this content.
items.infoLabel: Accessible name of the info icon.
items.border: Border tone. Forced to error when the field is invalid.
items.validRegex: Pattern the value must match. Failing values show the error border.
items.isDisabled: Disables the field and hides the button.
items.isRequired: Marks the field as required (aria-required + asterisk).
items.clearable: Shows a button that empties the field while it has a value.
items.clearLabel: Accessible name of the clear button.
items.wrapperClassName: Extra classes for the root container.
items.onChange: Native event. event.target.value is the real value, even with `maskCharacter`.
items.onVisibilityChange: Fires when the value is shown or hidden.
items.onValidate: Fires when validity changes based on `validRegex`.
items.onInfoClick: Fires when the info icon is activated.
items.onClear: Fires after the field is cleared with the button.
